title: Fix formatBytes for 0, negative, and >1024 TB inputs
body:
Fixes #402: empty files show "NaN undefined" in the file list.

**Cause:** `Math.log(0)` is `-Infinity`, so the unit index was `-Infinity` for 0-byte files. Values ≥ 1024 TB also indexed past the units array.

**Change:** `formatBytes` now returns `"0 B"` for 0, `"—"` for negative/non-finite input, and clamps the unit index to TB. Display-only helper; used in `FileRow` and `UploadDialog`. No API or storage changes.

**Verification:** Added table-driven tests in `tests/utils/formatBytes.test.ts` (0, 1, 1023, 1024, 1536, 1 MB, 1024 TB clamp, -5, NaN, Infinity). CI `test` job runs the full jest suite. Screenshot of file list with a 0-byte file attached below.

![file list](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/example/zero-byte.png)

**Review focus:** the clamp on line 10.
